facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Morris Lapidus and opened as The DiLido Hotel in 1953.
facts.excerpt: Designed by legendary architect Morris Lapidus and opened as The DiLido Hotel in 1953

facts.text: The hotel is on Lincoln Road in the heart of the Art Deco Historic District.
facts.excerpt: Located on famed Lincoln Road in the heart of the Art Deco Historic District

facts.text: Dining is by José Andrés Group at three venues: Zaytinya, Lapidus Bar and DiLido Beach Bar.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy globally inspired dining by José Andrés Group at Zaytinya, Lapidus Bar, and DiLido Beach Bar.

facts.text: Zaytinya is a mezze-style restaurant drawing on Turkish, Greek and Lebanese cuisines.
facts.excerpt: Zaytinya, our mezze-style restaurant in South Beach, Miami by José Andrés Group, draws inspiration from Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese cuisines

facts.text: DiLido Beach Bar offers Atlantic views and direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: offering refined ambiance, Atlantic views, and direct beach access.

facts.text: Lapidus Bar pays tribute to architect Morris Lapidus with bronze accents, craft cocktails and live music.
facts.excerpt: Lapidus Bar by José Andrés Group pays tribute to architect Morris Lapidus with bronze accents, craft cocktails, and live music

facts.text: The spa has 11 treatment rooms, a co-ed relaxation lounge, separate male and female lounges, and steam and sauna facilities.
facts.excerpt: features 11 tranquil treatment rooms, a co-ed relaxation lounge, separate male and female lounges, locker rooms, and steam and sauna facilities.

facts.text: Daily beachfront fitness classes are led by local instructors.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club presents complimentary culinary offerings five times a day, prepared by José Andrés Group, for Club guests.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club presents complimentary culinary offerings prepared by José Andrés Group.

facts.text: Club access requires a confirmed Club-level reservation, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not include complimentary Club Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires a confirmed Club-level reservation. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not include complimentary Club Lounge access.

facts.text: Ritz Kids offers daily programming for children ages 5-11, including beachfront activities.

facts.text: A private airboat experience in the Everglades, with private transportation and a narrated scenic drive, is offered as a curated adventure.
